subject: Review: AWS Marketplace offer visuals, pricing tiers, and architecture diagram
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace offer: visuals/pricing/diagram — quick pass?

Team,

We're aiming to push the AWS Marketplace offer into review next week. Attached is the current pricing tiers spreadsheet (pricing-tiers-table-v2.xlsx) and a link to the Drive folder with hero assets. Please do a quick pass on three things by EOD Tuesday:

- Hero copy + CTA wording (we want PLG-friendly, low-friction language)
- Pricing tiers: do the tier names & unit descriptions map to how we'd meter throughput?
- Architecture diagram: does the diagram clearly show the Hosted / Dedicated / Private deployment options and data flow? (Jonas I tagged a note where I think the KV cache should be called out)

High-level constraints from AWS AM: single-page PNG for the architecture (max 2MB), hero asset in 16:9 crop, and avoid the phrase "AI platform" in the one-liner — they prefer product-specific phrasing.

If you can't review everything, prioritize the one-liner + pricing labels.

Thanks — I'll loop in the AWS AM and Acme once we've consolidated.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
(attachment: pricing-tiers-table-v2.xlsx [XLSX])

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace offer: visuals/pricing/diagram — quick pass?

Thanks Karthik — quick notes inline and a suggested hero line attached.

- Hero one-liner: my pick is "Low-latency LLM inference for production apps" (shorter). Avoid "AI platform" per AM.
- CTA: "Start a trial" vs "Request demo" — for Marketplace listing we should surface "Start trial" where possible, with "Request demo" in the console.
- Pricing labels: rename "Pro" -> "Standard" and "Scale" -> "Enterprise"; clarify token vs. request billing in the next column.

Attached: final-hero-asset-02.jpg (cropped 16:9). I also made two micro-copy variants for the benefits bullets — see lines 8-12 in the JPG metadata.

On architecture: I think the diagram needs a clearer separator for customer-managed VPC in the Private deployment path — customers and AWS reviewers like a distinct network boundary. Jonas, can you add a dashed boundary and highlight KMS/HSM?

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Content | Redwood Inference
(attachment: final-hero-asset-02.jpg [JPG])

I've drafted an updated architecture PNG that follows AWS guidance: single page, labeled components, and a clear VPC boundary for Private. Key changes:
- Added KMS/HSM box on the Private path with arrows to the Control Plane.
- Highlighted KV cache and batch layer in the Hosted runtime path.
- Included a short legend for "Dedicated GPU pool" and throughput targets per pool.

Attachment: redwood-aws-offer-diagram-v3.png (draft 1.0). Size is 1.6MB — under the 2MB recommendation.

I also added two small callouts to show how requests fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant when capacity is constrained (that was a clarification AWS AM asked for previously).

Jonas

From: AWS Marketplace AM <aws-marketplace-am@amazon.com>

Cc: Emily Zhang <emily@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing checklist and diagram guidance

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Thanks for the updates and attachments. A few notes from the Marketplace review side:

- Diagram: the PNG looks good — please ensure all text is legible at 800px width. Keep file < 2MB (your current file is OK).
- One-liner: please avoid platform-level language; prefer solution-focused phrasing. The suggested "Low-latency LLM inference for production apps" is acceptable.
- Pricing: Marketplace prefers tier labels that map to product capabilities rather than marketing names. If you use "Standard"/"Enterprise" make sure the SKU mapping in your offer meta is one-to-one with pricing rows.
- Legal: include a short notice that customer data is not used to train models (this helps compliance reviewers).

If you can upload the final assets to the seller portal by Friday, we can schedule a formal review next Monday.

Regards,
Angela Lin
AWS Marketplace AM
aws-marketplace-am@amazon.com

Subject: Final assets uploaded & next steps for Marketplace review

All — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and actions:

What I uploaded to the seller portal / Drive:
- redwood-aws-offer-diagram-v3.png (final) — shows VPC boundary, KMS, KV cache callouts, fallback variants
- final-hero-asset-02.jpg — 16:9 crop, two micro-copy variants in metadata
- pricing-tiers-table-v2.xlsx — updated column mapping to SKUs and meter definitions

Open items / owners:
- Vanessa: finalize one-liner and CTA variant we deploy on the public offer (pick A/B preference by Thu 5/23)
- Jonas: confirm the diagram legend text (I left two TODO bullets) and export a 72dpi PNG for portal upload by Thu 5/23
- Marissa: confirm the SKU mapping in HubSpot + deal record (DEAL-4491) and add the pricing rows to the marketplace offer in the portal

Emily — thanks for the logo confirmation yesterday. If Acme has a preferred Marketplace listing blurb (50–80 chars), drop it here and we can incorporate.

AWS AM Angela — we've uploaded the assets for formal review. Please ping if anything else is required; we can do an expedited follow-up if needed.

I'll monitor the seller portal and schedule the Monday review slot if we hear back.

Karthik
